baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alerting interrogative أَرَءَيْتَ opens an إِن كَانَ conditional whose predicate is عَلَى ٱلْهُدَى.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance does not settle a fact; it recruits the addressee to judge a suspended case in which someone's being is tested against guidance.

activation_trace.role: The tell-me and alert formula makes the opening a demand to consider the conditional case rather than a report of eyesight.
Being and temporal predication supply the deliberately unresolved state posited by the conditional.
Gentle indication toward road or truth supplies the criterion against which that state is judged.

changed_reading.before: A question asking whether an unnamed person was guided.
changed_reading.after: An alerting request to adjudicate a live hypothetical: suppose the person really occupied guidance; how must the case then be evaluated?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَى combines being with the support preposition عَلَى and a root branch of course, aim, and direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance becomes a position maintained upon a traversable course, not merely an inward property possessed by a person.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight asks the addressee to inspect the person's actual placement.
Place, position, or rank turns being into an occupied stance carried by عَلَى.
Course, manner, and intended direction make guidance the trajectory on which the person is situated.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is a binary moral label attached to the subject.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is an occupied and inspectable course: the question asks where the subject stands, how he is oriented, and what direction his conduct sustains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْهُدَى can activate a branch of calm stillness and composed bearing within the predicate عَلَى ٱلْهُدَى.
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional can test an observable manner of holding oneself, allowing guidance to appear as non-panicked steadiness as well as correct direction.

activation_trace.role: Calm stillness and composed bearing give guidance a visible bodily and affective manner.
Being or occurring lets that composed manner function as the condition under examination.

changed_reading.before: The conditional concerns only doctrinal correctness.
changed_reading.after: It may also ask whether the subject's very bearing manifests a calm, non-routed form of guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading, disclosure, and the writing implement turn the baseline act of adjudication into evidence-work: guidance is a direction whose marks can be gathered, taught, and inspected.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment anchors the focus question as an act of considered assessment.
Clarifying a road or truth supplies the object that the surrounding knowledge practices make legible.
Reading, recitation, and causing another to read establish active reception and articulation of signs.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower makes hidden orientation available for judgment.
The sharpened writing stick gives disclosure a durable, examinable trace.

structural_cues: The repeated reading and teaching sequence precedes the focus question, so the question arrives after an apparatus of acquiring what was not known.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reading, disclosure, and inscription; I infer that they furnish evidence for judging the conditional. A live alternative is that they frame knowledge generally without prescribing an evidentiary procedure.

changed_reading.before: Consider whether the person bears the label of guidance.
changed_reading.after: Read the person's course: guidance is a legible and teachable orientation whose effects can answer the conditional.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment supplies creaturely dependence, self-seen independence releases boundary-crossing force, and return closes the circuit. Being upon guidance can therefore mean remaining rightly borne within relations of support and return.

activation_trace.role: Course and intended direction anchor the focus in a trajectory that can remain ordered or exceed its bounds.
Clinging to and depending on another supplies the initial relational support denied by imagined self-sufficiency.
Rising water and sweeping force image transgression as energy that escapes a containing course.
Wealth and self-sufficiency supply the perceived release from dependence that precedes overflow.
Returning or being restored to what was supplies the terminal reversal of claimed autonomy.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from origin in attachment to transgression caused by self-perceived independence and then to unavoidable return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, overflow, self-sufficiency, and return; I infer a causal arc in which denied dependence deforms direction. Alternatively, these may be adjacent descriptions without a single hydraulic or relational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Being on guidance means holding correct beliefs.
changed_reading.after: Being on guidance means inhabiting dependence without mistaking support for autonomy: a bounded course that neither floods its limits nor forgets its return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same seeing root moves among self-appraisal, repeated demands that the addressee consider, and a final seeing beyond the actor. The focus question becomes a contest over which viewpoint can truthfully identify guidance.

activation_trace.role: The tell-me formula summons the addressee into an explicit act of judgment.
Visible appearance and mirror imagery make the actor's self-seeing a potentially closed reflective surface.
Self-sufficiency is the conclusion produced inside that self-appraisal.
Disclosure to a knower opposes the actor's private verdict with knowledge that is not confined to his viewpoint.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the encompassing observation that closes the sequence of disputed perceptions.

structural_cues: Forms of seeing recur at 96:7, 96:9, 96:11, 96:13, and 96:14, shifting the grammatical observer while the conduct under view remains contested.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-seeing, interrogative seeing, knowing, and final seeing; I infer an epistemic hierarchy among them. The mirror closure is analogical, and the alternative is simple repetition for emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The opening asks a neutral observer to look at a guided subject.
changed_reading.after: The opening interrupts a self-confirming gaze and asks whose seeing can establish the truth of the subject's direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint is exercised against a socially subordinate worshipper, yet the conditional can place that obstructed person on guidance and extend his action into protective command. Visible power and normative authority are reversed.

activation_trace.role: Guidance toward road or truth supplies authority that need not coincide with social dominance.
Forbidding and restraining supply the coercive act whose legitimacy the focus question reopens.
Humble worship and obedience characterize the blocked person's action from within rather than by his rank.
The specific act of worship makes the servant's submission concrete at the moment of restraint.
Request and obligation allow the apparently subordinate person to become a source of normative direction.
Repelling harm by protection gives that commanded direction a protective rather than merely prohibitive function.

structural_cues: The focus conditional follows 'a servant when he prays,' leaving the praying servant as a live subject for كَانَ and the following أَمَرَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a restrainer, a praying servant, guidance, and protective command; I assign the pronoun of كَانَ to the servant and infer a reversal of visible rank. The prohibiter remains a materially live alternative antecedent.

changed_reading.before: A powerful observer determines whether a subordinate is guided.
changed_reading.after: The obstructed servant may be the one standing on guidance and issuing protection-bearing direction, while the person able to stop him may lack authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Keeping the prohibiter as the subject makes the focus a deliberately favorable hypothesis placed beside the later adverse hypothesis. The discourse tests even an opponent's claim to guidance before naming denial and retreat.

activation_trace.role: The alerting tell-me formula initiates a case test rather than presupposing the answer.
Guidance toward truth supplies the favorable possibility temporarily granted to the prohibiter.
Forbidding identifies the nearby actor whose conduct is placed under both conditional tests.
Command or obligation extends the favorable hypothesis from inward guidance to outward direction.
Protecting against harm specifies the beneficial end that such command would need to serve.
Contradiction of truth supplies the adverse branch of the paired evaluation.
Turning away supplies the adverse actor's directional withdrawal after denial.

structural_cues: The two nearby formulas أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ and أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ create favorable and adverse conditional files around an unresolved pronoun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired conditionals around the prohibiter; I keep him as the nearer antecedent and infer a charitable-before-adverse test. Alternatively, the first conditional concerns the servant and the second switches back to the prohibiter.

changed_reading.before: The question simply praises an already identified guided person.
changed_reading.after: The question provisionally asks whether even the prohibiter might claim a guidance-and-protection rationale, before the paired denial-and-retreat condition exposes the rival account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance as course is sharpened by a three-part contrary vector: falsifying the true description, turning away, and failing to hit the right mark. The condition asks about sustained orientation, not a static badge.

activation_trace.role: Course, aim, and intended direction establish guidance as a vector of conduct.
Opposition to truth corrupts the account by which the actor's direction is named.
Turning the back and withdrawing gives falsehood an enacted direction away.
Missing the correct point or passing beyond it renders error as failed targeting.

structural_cues: The favorable إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَى is answered by the adverse إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى and then by the predicate خَاطِئَة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies course, falsehood, bodily retreat, and missed correctness; I infer a unified directional vector across them. Alternatively, the terms may remain independent moral predicates without a spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is one isolated quality among several.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is the positive branch of a behavioral fork: truthful targeting and maintained orientation stand opposite falsification, turning away, and missing the mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch makes guidance a leading front; the later forelock becomes the contested control point. Forced seizure of the false front is then answered by voluntary lowering of the head and approach.

activation_trace.role: The first or leading front part lets guidance register as what heads and steers a moving body.
Taking by the forelock turns directional control into a concrete act of seizure.
The forelock and grasping it locate the contest at the body's leading edge.
Bowing the head supplies a voluntary redirection of the same leading edge.
Nearness makes that voluntary lowering terminate in approach rather than defeat.

structural_cues: The later sequence names the forelock twice and ends with imperatives to bow and draw near, creating a head-and-direction pattern around the focus predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a leading-front branch, forelock seizure, head-bowing, and nearness; I infer that control of one's leading edge externalizes guidance. The alternative is that the body imagery is rhetorical and the focus branch is not activated.

changed_reading.before: To be on guidance is an invisible mental state.
changed_reading.after: To be on guidance may be to have one's leading edge rightly directed: coercion grabs the false front, while chosen prostration reorients the guided body toward nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Call and counter-call externalize two rival alignments: one invokes an assembled social circle, the other agents of repulsion. The focus conditional becomes a legitimacy test that crowd and force cannot answer by themselves.

activation_trace.role: Position or rank anchors the question in where the subject stands amid competing alignments.
Course and intended direction provide a criterion distinct from the size or force of an alliance.
Calling and drawing others by speech initiate the public attempt to reinforce one side.
The people's council or assembly gives that call a social body and visible prestige.
The answering call mirrors the first summons and exposes the scene as competing mobilization.
Pushing, striking, and preventing supply the counter-force that can break the first assembly's coercive confidence.

structural_cues: The matched forms فَلْيَدْعُ and سَنَدْعُ stage a call and counter-call immediately before the final command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons, an assembly, a counter-summons, and repelling force; I infer rival claims of alignment whose legitimacy is judged by guidance. Alternatively, the exchange is only threat escalation, not a social model.

changed_reading.before: The conditional judges an isolated individual's inner state.
changed_reading.after: The conditional asks where a person truly stands when public councils and coercive responders can both be summoned; mobilization itself does not establish guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final commands enact the focus predicate through selective allegiance: refusing submission to the blocker, voluntarily lowering oneself, and thereby approaching. Guidance is composed action whose downward movement produces nearness.

activation_trace.role: Calm stillness and composed bearing give the guided stance resilience under command and threat.
Submission and obedience identify the allegiance explicitly refused toward the prohibiter.
Lowering and humbling supply the positively chosen posture that replaces obedience to coercion.
Drawing near makes approach the spatial result of chosen lowering.

structural_cues: The coordinated imperatives لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب move from refusal through bodily descent to approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-obedience, lowering, and nearness; I read their order as a causal and spatial enactment of guidance. A live alternative is that the imperatives are coordinated duties without a directional arrow among them.

changed_reading.before: Being upon guidance is a passive elevated status.
changed_reading.after: Being upon guidance is enacted through correctly allocated obedience: the guided person lowers himself without capitulating and, paradoxically, descent becomes approach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ر و ي mapping under the focus seeing root and should not replace the ordinary syntax of أَرَءَيْتَ. It remains packet-anchored through the split mapping and is reinforced by reading and writing branches; downstream prose should render it only as a transmission echo in how the case is posed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus أَرَءَيْتَ has a packet-supplied non-dominant branch of relaying reports and poetry, while ٱلْهُدَى supplies a course to be communicated.

activation_trace.role: Relaying reports and poetry recasts the interrogative act as receiving, retaining, and passing on a narrated case.
Course and intended direction provide the content whose trajectory the report asks the hearer to assess.
Reading and recitation activate an oral reception channel for the focus case.
The writing implement supplies the complementary durable channel by which the case can be preserved.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily: have you received and rehearsed the report of this case well enough to transmit its test of direction?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The protected person or captive branch is not the default gloss of ٱلْهُدَى, so the reading is a legal-social resonance rather than a lexical substitution. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the servant, restraint, and protection sequence; downstream prose should qualify the obstructed servant as figuratively under inviolable protection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus guidance root includes a branch for a protected person or captive, activated when a servant is restrained and protection is commanded.

activation_trace.role: The protected person or captive called hady lets the focus predicate carry an echo of inviolability under constraint.
Forbidding and restraint supply the act that places the person's freedom of worship under pressure.
Bondage and ownership sharpen the social vulnerability carried by the word servant.
Repelling harm by protection activates the focus branch's latent claim of inviolability.

changed_reading.before: The servant is merely the vulnerable object of another person's prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The vulnerable servant may simultaneously be the protected party: restraint does not cancel, and may expose, his inviolable standing on guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because quenching comes from the non-dominant ر و ي mapping under أَرَءَيْتَ and must not be translated into the focus wording. It remains anchored by the focus course branch and a packet-wide sequence of quenching, overflowing water, returning water, and moisture; downstream prose should present it as hydraulic imagery for regulated versus excessive force.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a non-dominant quenching branch under أَرَءَيْتَ with guidance as course and intended direction.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst introduce a form-distant image of water reaching sufficiency.
Course and intended direction give that water image a channel and destination.
Rising water and sweeping force provide the contrary image of flow exceeding its bounds.
Returning rain or water supplies recirculation after overflow rather than autonomous escape.
Moisture, rain, and dampness keep the water image latent even inside the later social confrontation.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and transgression are static opposed labels.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance channels force toward sufficiency and return, while transgression is the same vital movement swollen into boundary-breaking overflow.

strongest_changes: The focus question became an adjudicative conditional rather than a request for bare visual confirmation.
Attachment, imagined self-sufficiency, overflow, and return recast guidance as rightly inhabited dependence.
Repeated seeing created competing epistemic positions: self-appraisal, addressed judgment, and encompassing observation.
The unresolved pronoun sustains two coexisting readings, one elevating the blocked servant and one testing the prohibiter under favorable and adverse hypotheses.
Forelock seizure, prostration, and nearness embodied guidance as control and voluntary redirection of the leading edge.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made guidance unusually spatial, relational, and bodily. Split mappings also preserved live but contained echoes of report transmission and water regulation, while social branches turned the conditional into a test of authority that neither rank, assembly, nor force can settle.
remaining_uncertainties: The subject of كَانَ can remain the praying servant or the prohibiter; choosing one would erase a productive reversal.
The causal arrows from dependence to overflow and from prostration to nearness are reader-supplied readings of sequence, not explicit connectives.
The leading-front activation of ه د ي is branch-backed but may be a cross-domain resonance rather than a semantic pressure in this occurrence.
The ر و ي outliers depend on a non-dominant split mapping and should remain imagery, never replacement glosses.
